title: Clash between Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)
RFI Number: RFI-2026-001
Subject: Clash between 600mm Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04 at Level 02
Contract Reference: CON-2026-CS-001
Drawing Reference: DR-S-201, DR-M-402
Raised Date: 2026-02-10
Due Date: 2026-02-17
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Coordinated BIM model review reveals that the 600mm diameter chilled water supply/return risers shown on DR-M-402 physically intersect post-tensioned transfer girder TG-04 (Gridline 4-D) shown on DR-S-201. Core drilling through girder TG-04 is prohibited due to high post-tensioning tendon congestion. Please provide engineering direction on riser diversion or structural sleeve allowance.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-02-14
Confirmed: Do not sleeve or drill transfer girder TG-04. Offset chilled water risers 1200mm westward into adjacent service riser shaft S-02 per structural sketch SK-S-201-A. Mechanical subcontractor to submit revision for additional 90-degree elbows and pipe length.
